title: ExpressNFT
tagline: We are building a mechanism to allow for locking up NFTs for use in larger Meta-NFTs. In designing out this mechanism, we also believe it would be useful as a generalized tool for a variety of purposes.
description: We began to fork out existing code to build out and test our mechanism architecture, but ran into time constraint issues. We decided that instead of simply not presenting, we would spec out the mechanism and architecture and present the possibilities for consideration. We fully intend to continue developing this mechanism, as it is key to one of our contributors' major projects.
